releases.title: Room to breathe on big screens

items: On laptops and desktops the study controls sit in a column on the left and the card gets the rest of the width, from 960 pixels wide; mid-sized screens get a wider single column.
On large screens (1,440 pixels and up) the app grows wider still, with bigger characters on the card.
The progress, word list and other sheets are wider on large screens.
Fill the gap no longer marks a word wrong when it also fits the sentence, such as 能 in 你＿说汉语吗. All 783 gaps were checked, and 17 had a second right answer; those words are no longer offered.

releases.title: More languages and a can-do ladder

items: Meanings and example sentences in German, Spanish and Romanian, next to English and Hungarian. Switch each language on or off in Settings → Translations.
Every translation went through several independent reviews: accuracy, native fluency, and a side-by-side check of all three languages.
Search finds words in all five languages.
A can-do ladder: real-life steps such as 打招呼 greeting people or 点菜 ordering food. Reach a step by knowing all its words in reading and listening, in any order, for 40 XP each.
A strip on the main screen shows the next step and how many words it still needs; Practise studies just those words. The progress view has a new Ladder tab.

A right answer (I know it, Hard, Good, Easy, or a right quiz answer) keeps a word in Learning until its next review is a week or more away; then it becomes Known. Words you already marked Known stay Known.
Cards and the word list show the mark in all three skills: 读 reading, 说 recall, 听 listening.
The panda moved to the top left of the screen.
A sync button in the top bar while you are signed in (website): tap to sync now; a dot means changes are waiting to upload.
On the website, the footer now says when your progress is also synced to your account.
The “which copy to keep” sync dialog shows both copies side by side, with clear, evenly laid-out buttons.
Undo the last answer with Z (or Ctrl+Z / ⌘Z).
Tapping the meanings or examples no longer hides them; tap the characters at the top of the card to hide the answer.
A “What’s new” link at the bottom of the page, so the release notes stay one tap away.
Clearer Chinese labels, as a native speaker would expect them: 学习中 Learning, 新卡片 New, 易错 Hardest, 成就 on the Collection tab, 语音 Voice, 中文怎么说 for Meaning → 汉字.
Character hints reviewed again: smoother Hungarian in 51 hints, and debated origins (明, 坐, 拿, 好, 男…) now say “traditionally” or name the alternative.

releases.title: Games, a panda and Chinese labels

groups.name: New ways to practise
items: Fill the gap: pick the word that completes its example sentence.
Build the sentence: put a sentence's words back in order.
Similar words: tell apart look-alikes and sound-alikes such as 买/卖 and 他/她/它.
Type the pinyin in Meaning → 汉字, with tone numbers or tone marks.
Hard, Good and Easy after each answer, and reviews that grow to 60 and 120 days.
Memory hints for 180 characters on the back of word cards.

groups.name: Your progress in real terms
items: How many example sentences you can read, and the next one to unlock.
How much of everyday Chinese your words cover, and how common each word is (#5 most used).
16 topics to study one area at a time, each with its own seal.
A 7-day forecast of coming reviews, and a stats page.

groups.name: Daily motivation and games
items: Word of the day, three daily quests, and streak freezes that save a missed day.
XP and ranks from 新手 to 大师, a 连 combo counter, and 20 seals to collect.
A 60-second blitz and a 20-question exam for each HSK level.
宝宝 the panda grows as you study. Tap it to say hello.
A weekly recap every Monday.

groups.name: Look and feel
items: Chinese labels on buttons and headings (Settings → Interface labels).
A new answer bar with 学 and 会 seals, and gentle animations.
The progress view has Today, Progress and Collection tabs.
More room for the card on phones, and bigger tap targets.
Fixed: on an installed iPhone app the top bar sat under the status bar.

releases.title: More ways to read and listen

items: 汉字 only: practise reading characters with the pinyin hidden.
Which tone?: hear a word and pick the tone of its first syllable.
Tap any word in a sentence to see its pinyin and meaning.
Optional fading pinyin for cards you know well, and optional pinyin in multiple choice.
Reading, recall and listening keep separate progress; words and sentences keep their place.
The version is shown in Settings.
Sign in with an email link to sync progress between devices (website only).
If two devices changed progress, the app asks which copy to keep instead of overwriting.
The 777 example sentences as cards of their own.
Export and import progress to move it between devices.
Install the website to your home screen; it works offline.
Keyboard and screen-reader improvements.
A help page and a four-step tour for the first visit.
598 HSK 1–3 words with pinyin, English, Hungarian and example sentences.
Read-aloud with a choice of Chinese voices, tone colours and swipe cards.
Spaced repetition, daily goal, streak and a progress view.
